dev_jordan: Hey team — hitting a weird runtime error when deploying a Next.js Edge route that imports the Node SDK. Build passes but edge deploy fails with `SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'`.

support_sam: can you share the SDK version, import line, and package.json exports/type fields?

dev_jordan: SDK@2.3.1. Import is `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference'` in app/api/route.ts. package.json has:
```
"type": "module",
"exports": {
  ".": {"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs"}
}
```
Next config: `export const runtime = 'experimental-edge'`.

eng_alex: which bundler are you using — turbopack or webpack?

dev_jordan: Next 13.4 default is turbopack experimental. If I switch to webpack dev, error changes to `ReferenceError: require is not defined` pointing at `dist/index.cjs`.

support_sam: sounds like the bundler is resolving to the CJS entry in an ESM-only runtime. Can you run:
```
node -p "require('redwood-inference/package.json').exports"
```
and paste the output?

dev_jordan: output: `{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs"}`

pm_maya: common pattern: some bundlers prefer the CJS/main path or the presence of "type": "module" can be ignored by older resolvers. Also TS emit settings can mismatch.

eng_alex: quick workarounds: 1) publish a dedicated `./edge` entry in exports that points to the ESM build and import `redwood-inference/edge` from your edge code; or 2) force ESM externals in Next via `experimental.esmExternals`.

dev_jordan: I tried adding `redwood-inference/edge` export in package.json, but Next still bundled the cjs variant. Here's the minimal repro steps I used:
1) npx create-next-app@13 --typescript
2) add `import { Client } from 'redwood-inference'` in app/api/route.ts
3) npm run build -> deploy fails with `SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'`

Error log snippet:
```
Serverless: Error: Unexpected token 'export'
 at wrap (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:999:11)
 at Module._compile (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:1060:5)
 at Object.Module._extensions..js (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:1158:10)
 at Module.load (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:981:32)
 at Function.Module._load (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:822:14)
```

support_sam: thanks — we're able to reproduce locally with turbopack+edge runtime. Quick note: we identified a packaging bug in v2.3.1 where the build pipeline omitted the `module` field and a few conditional exports entrypoints that some bundlers rely on. Also the `types` field was missing which caused TS consumers to fallback to the cjs typings.

eng_alex: fix pushed in 2.3.4: we added `"module": "dist/index.mjs"` and expanded `exports` to include an explicit `./edge` and ESM-first matrix. Also added `types` and adjusted rollup config so turbopack resolves to the ESM entry.

dev_jordan: installed `redwood-inference@2.3.4` and rebuilt the repro — deploy succeeds now. Good catch, thanks!

pm_maya: filing release note and we should notify customers pinned to 2.3.1. I'll add a short migration note: "If you're using Next Edge or other ESM-only runtimes, upgrade to >=2.3.4. Workarounds: import `redwood-inference/edge` or set `experimental.esmExternals: true` in next.config.js." :email:

deploy_bot: action items queued: update changelog, tag release notes, create customer communication draft.

support_sam: leaving this thread open for a bit — shout if anyone else hits related packaging edge cases.
